comment: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, CC BY 4.0. previous_dayN: forecasts made N days before the valid time; both leads are complete from 2024-03-08. Points that drive GB carbon intensity: wind (onshore Scotland, offshore North Sea and Irish Sea), solar (southern England), demand through temperature (large cities). JSON, not YAML, so that the archive job (standard library only) can read it.
